title: Infective Endocarditis (IE) risque de mortalité score
formula:
The IE Mortality Score is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Constant | | 4 |
| Host factors | | |
| Age, years | ≤45 | 0 |
| 46-60 | 2 | |
| 61-70 | 3 | |
| >70 | 4 | |
| History of dialysis | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| IE factors | | |
| Nosocomial IE | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Prosthetic IE | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Symptoms >1 month before admission | No | 0 |
| Yes | -1 | |
| Staphylococcus aureus | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Viridans group streptococci | No | 0 |
| Yes | -2 | |
| Aortic vegetation | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Mitral vegetation | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| IE complications | | |
| NYHA class 3 or 4 heart failure | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| Stroke | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Paravalvular complication | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Persistent bacteremia | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Surgical treatment | No | 0 |
| Yes | -2 | |

how_to_use.why: Le score TheIEMortality fournit une estimation objective de la mortalité.
how_to_use.when: Patients atteints d'IE confirmée pour estimer la mortalité.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Infective endocarditis (IE) has an overall 6-month mortality of approximately 25% in all-comers.
- Older age and history of dialysis appear to be the highest risk patient factors; IE complications also suggest a high mortality as well.
- Surgery is associated with a lower mortality rate but is infrequent in the high-risk cohort of patients.
- Mortality ranges from 10% in the lowest risk quintile to 53% in the highest-risk quintile.

**Points to keep in mind:**

- Surgery in this study was associated with lower mortality, but the highest risk patients were less likely to receive surgery (probably because they were high-risk surgical patients as well).
- This study was performed in referral centers (likely tertiary and quaternary academic centers) with experience with endocarditis and cardiac surgery.

next_steps.advice: Les patients atteints d’EI peuvent bénéficier d’une consultation avec les services de chirurgie cardiothoracique et de maladies infectieuses.

evidence:
- Les statistiques c pour les modèles de dérivation et de validation sont de 0,715 et 0,682, respectivement.
- La cohorte de dérivation contenait 4049 patients, et la cohorte de validation incluait 1197 sujets.
more_info:
**Interpretation:**

Probability of 6‐month mortality = 2.416*score+0.109*score^2^−4.849

A simplified risk score ≥8 had sensitivity 86.7% and specificity 50.8% for predicting overall 6‐month mortality (negative predictive value of 86% and positive predictive value of 39%).
medium_description: Predicts mortalité at 6 months chez les patients avec infective endocarditis.
